agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Controller and broker must derive the exact same canonical-object SHA-256 for the reviewed WorkOrder before broker readiness.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Attempt 001 hashed canonical JSON with a trailing newline while the broker hashed the parsed canonical object without that newline, so the broker rejected before ready and before provider I/O.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Immutable attempt-001 terminal plus static controller/broker comparison isolated the distinct digest algorithms with zero native, model or provider calls.

correction.action: Bind the controller environment to the shared canonical-object digest and add a real provider-free controller-to-broker readiness regression.
correction.prevention_control: A single imported canonical-object digest owns both sides of every WorkOrder handshake and the real broker seam is exercised before occupied dispatch.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the attempt-001 newline-sensitive WorkOrder digest mismatch and the shared canonical-object regression control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Cleanup must preserve the initiating failure coordinate and remove the exact root despite Windows read-only Git objects.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Attempt 001 cleanup failed on read-only Git object files and the immutable terminal exposed only cleanup failure instead of preserving the earlier broker handshake rejection.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Separate exact-root cleanup recovery found three read-only Git object files and static terminal ordering showed the initiating coordinate had been overwritten.

correction.action: Clear only exact-root read-only attributes during bounded removal and append cleanup failure to the initiating coordinate instead of replacing it.
correction.prevention_control: Terminal construction retains the first failure and exact-root cleanup has a bounded Windows read-only callback with literal descendant checks.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the cleanup-masked initiating failure and the first-cause-preserving exact-root repair.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected manual Git-ref narrative and the already active machine-snapshot-only control.
